0022600184.text: The Dallas Mavericks (4-3, 10th in the West and 2.5 games back in the Southwest) visit the San Antonio Spurs (5-2, 6th in the West) for Dallas's eighth game of the season, with Dallas coming off a loss while San Antonio has won five straight. The Spurs beat Dallas 122-106 in Dallas on October 24, the only meeting so far in 2026-27, and the Mavericks lost all four games against San Antonio in 2025-26. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II, Kyrie Irving, Santi Aldama, Sergio de Larrea and Tarik Biberovic, and Max Christie is day-to-day with a hip injury and a game-time decision, while San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance and Tobias Harris.
